propositions: Subpackage import failures and optional-dependency import breakage are not caught by the current wheel-probe step which only runs `import rebar` and entry-point `--help` calls.

Scripts modules can fail to import when sys.path is not properly configured, as demonstrated by the `alert_dedup` escape where a sibling script's sys.path.insert masked a missing insert in another script.
The wheel probe must walk every rebar.* module under the installed package and every top-level scripts/*.py in isolation to detect all import regressions and report all failures non-fatally.

Expected-optional modules (those legitimately absent when certain extras are not installed) must be distinguished from real failures by checking that the ModuleNotFoundError name matches the declared dependency and that dependency is absent.
